scope.boundary: Reconstruct the exact retained XML document, including its complete head and every ordered body child. This is a source-member boundary, not a claim that the member proves the complete intellectual work, edition, or parts.

mapping.ThML: Represent the root/head/body envelope in TEI and the source-accountability sidecar; do not load or fetch the external DTD.
mapping.ThML.head: Transcribe source-record title, creator labels, publisher, Created date, identifier, language, subjects, and description into typed TEI header fields. Preserve the source-record date as Created, not as edition or original-publication date. Inventory every other header element, attribute, and empty field.
mapping.div1/div2/div: Map in source order to TEI div; preserve id as xml:id and source title/class as n or type. Preserve observed prev/next navigation attributes exactly in the TEI when allowed by the bound schema and in the accountability ledger in all cases.
mapping.h1/h2/h3/h6: Map a source heading to TEI head with its source level in type when it is the first element child of its source div1/div2. A later source heading maps at the same parent and position to TEI p with rend=source-heading-h1/source-heading-h2/source-heading-h3/source-heading-h6; this preserves its text, order, id, and heading-level marker without placing a second TEI head where the pinned schema disallows one.
mapping.p: Map to TEI p; preserve source id, class rendition, mixed content, and exact text/tail order.
mapping.a: Map to TEI ref; preserve the source class and href as type and target with no query, fragment, or ID remapping.
mapping.scripRef: Map to TEI ref type=scripture; preserve source id, OSIS reference as target, and passage label as n. Keep parsed source-index attributes in accountability.
mapping.scripCom: Map to TEI anchor type=scripture-commentary-marker; preserve source id, OSIS reference, passage label, and source type. Keep parsed source-index attributes in accountability.
mapping.insertIndex: Map to TEI anchor type=index-insertion; preserve source id and source type as subtype.
mapping.comments: Preserve body comments at their source positions in TEI and record every document/header/body comment in accountability.
mapping.processing_instructions_and_doctype: Record exact location and values in accountability; do not copy the external DTD or stylesheet processing instructions into the TEI document.
mapping.style: Do not reproduce CCEL CSS/XCSS formatting. Record element positions, attributes, text lengths, and hashes in accountability, with disposition source-formatting-not-reproduced.
mapping.unknown_elements: Fail closed on any source element, attribute class, or mixed-content node outside this work-specific mapping.

attribute_policy.other_profiled_element_classes: Every element class omitted from names_by_source_element has no attributes in the complete-source profile; any new class or attribute fails closed.

source_specific_variants.p: Every source p has exactly id or class; there are 3168 id-only and 130 class-only paragraphs.
source_specific_variants.scripCom: Every source scripCom has id and type; OSIS reference, parsed, and passage attributes occur only where retained and are accounted exactly.

attribute_policy.nonprojected_attributes: Every retained source attribute name and exact value is listed in source-accountability.json, including parsed scripture-index attributes.

identity_policy.catalog_work_id: The LIB-055 assignment and source title support this route binding; they do not settle equivalence of the retained member to the full catalog-work boundary.
identity_policy.textual_form: Unknown; retain observed language eng and do not infer a translation or revision.
identity_policy.edition: Unknown; distinguish electronic-header Created date from title-page statements about first publication and reprints.
identity_policy.parts: Unknown; report the exact source-native divisions without asserting an authoritative part or volume map.
identity_policy.witness: Bind the retained XML bytes only; do not infer the print transcription witness or proofreading history.
identity_policy.translator: Unknown; no translator is recorded in the inspected ThML header.

rights_and_attribution.permitted_operation: Parsing CCEL ThML/XML for text is explicitly permitted.
rights_and_attribution.restriction: Do not sell CCEL files or derivatives of their formatting.
rights_and_attribution.attribution: Include the phrase sourced via CCEL.org in the human-readable source README.
rights_and_attribution.status: This permission and attribution convention do not establish publication rights clearance.

independent_check.source: The oracle independently reads the exact retained bytes and enumerates source nodes, attributes, text/tails, links, IDs, shell nodes, and body carriers. It must not import producer traversal, mapping, selection, or completeness helpers.
independent_check.candidate: Compare every readable TEI node and meaningful attribute to the independently enumerated source expectations; validate against the manifest-bound local TEI schema; verify the five candidate members and all bindings.
required_mutations: omit or duplicate a top-level carrier
alter a scripture reference or commentary marker
change a source heading or source-record metadata value
remove or reorder a body comment
independent_check.determinism: Generate the exact package in two clean processes and compare member path sets and bytes.

review_boundary: A passing candidate is nonaccepted. CVW visual comparison, human acceptance, rights clearance, promotion, release, and publication remain separate gates.
